label: American Taxpayer Relief Act
description: Made Bush-era tax cuts permanent for incomes below $400K.
fiscalImpact: +$3.97T vs current law / -$737B vs current policy

label: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act
description: Corporate rate cut from 35% to 21% with broad individual tax changes.

label: Section 301 tariffs begin
description: 25% tariff tranche on $34B of Chinese imports; later expanded.
fiscalImpact: Trade action escalated toward ~$370B coverage by Sep 2019

label: CARES Act
description: $2.2T COVID relief package including checks and PPP.

label: Consolidated Approps 2021
description: $900B COVID relief follow-on with additional direct payments.

label: Inflation Reduction Act
description: Climate and healthcare package with deficit reduction components.

label: Fiscal Responsibility Act
description: Debt ceiling deal with spending caps and COVID fund rescissions.

label: China fentanyl tariffs
description: Additional tariffs on Chinese imports under IEEPA authority.

label: Canada/Mexico tariff action
description: 25% tariff action on Canada and Mexico goods with retaliation.

label: Liberation Day tariffs
description: 10% baseline tariff with higher country-specific rates.
fiscalImpact: Broad tariff action across most imports

label: China tariff escalation
description: China-related tariff stack escalated to 145% total rate.

label: US-China tariff reduction window
description: Geneva talks framework reduced rates during a 90-day window.

label: One Big Beautiful Bill Act
description: Tax and spending package including TCJA extension, energy and border provisions, and discretionary funding changes.
fiscalImpact: Deficit increase under both current-law and current-policy baselines (CBO 10yr estimates)
